verdict.rationale: AWS documents the Cost Explorer API for programmatically querying cost and usage data, so the queryable-API core of the story is met by the product itself. The pack has no evidence of scheduled exports or of resource-level cost granularity, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring cost exports, resource-level granularity in cost data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, cost data is queryable — a billing/cost API and scheduled exports with resource-level granularity, not just a dashboard screenshot

citations.quote: You can use the Cost Explorer API to programmatically query your cost and usage data.
